gloss: roar of laughter; burst of laughter

definitions.gloss: roar of laughter; burst of laughter
definitions.explanation: loud, explosive laughter, especially from a group

examples.japanese: {会場|かいじょう}が{爆笑|ばくしょう}に{包|つつ}まれた。
examples.english: The venue was filled with roars of laughter.

examples.japanese: その{冗談|じょうだん}に{思|おも}わず{爆笑|ばくしょう}した。
examples.english: I burst out laughing at that joke.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{物真似|ものまね}は{毎回|まいかい}{爆笑|ばくしょう}を{誘|さそ}う。
examples.english: His impersonation always invites roars of laughter.

notes:
VERB FORM:
{爆笑|ばくしょう}する - to burst out laughing

ORIGINAL MEANING:
Traditionally, {爆笑|ばくしょう} referred specifically to a group of people laughing loudly together. However, modern usage often applies it to individuals as well.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}を{誘|さそ}う - to invite roars of laughter
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}ネタ - hilarious material/joke
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}{問題|もんだい} - comedy duo name (Bakusho Mondai)

INTERNET SLANG:
wwwww (representing {笑|わら}) and {草|くさ} are internet equivalents for expressing laughter.
